notes: V3.3.1 — Data portability & honesty. Import a backup to restore your data, and delete just your on-device check-in history (mood, voice, camera) without touching anything else. Added clear info notes distinguishing estimated/interpretive signals from measurements (coherence is a breathing-based proxy, not a clinical HRV reading; solfeggio framing is contemplative, not clinical). Everything stays on your device.
